metadata.geography_basis: Exact parcelREID intersection with independently agreeing county and city active-address ZIP27260 records; source situs ZIP alone is not trusted.
metadata.data_freshness: Retrieved now; latest reported transfer date is not a feed update timestamp. This layer supplies current parcel sale attributes, not every historical transaction.
metadata.area_basis: Explicit county MAIN_BUILDING_HEATED_AREA field; retains county total HEATED_AREA separately. Current building characteristics can postdate a transfer.
metadata.rough_cohort_policy: Only county RESIDENTIAL/01-SFR, one building and unit, positive matching main/total heated area, price above3000, deed reference within31calendar days of reported sale, no observed duplicate deed/REID or additional land sale. Arm-length and condition remain unverified; never verified ARV. Thresholds are conservative analyst screening policy, not county sale-validity codes.
metadata.duplicate_scope: Duplicate deed check spans all selected countywide recent current parcel rows, including parcels outside27260. Older rows overwritten by a later transfer and historical parcel changes can conceal packages.
metadata.price_source_code_meaning: County code retained verbatim (for example REV). No code definition or sale-validity field is published on this layer; no arm-length inference is made.
limits: Not a complete transaction history; cannot prove a historical flip pair, rehab spend, interior condition or renovation premium.
Related-party, fractional-interest, foreclosure, package allocation and other nonmarket transfers may remain.
No time/condition/location adjustments are inferred from rawpricepersqft.
Current structures can differ from those present at sale.
County tax assessment is not used as saleprice.
metadata.access: Public Query endpoint and public portal item; no credentials, private APIs, site-interaction bypass, owner/contact/mailing fields requested.
metadata.usage: Portal access=public and licenseInfo=null. No explicit unrestricted reuse license is supplied; retain county attribution and source links, and county no-warranty/data-currentness caveats. This statement is not a legal permission guarantee.
